radioCases.name: first-obs-full-site
radioCases.expect: Diamond Mountain, stand by for your 0900 Weather observation. Taken near the 659 road at an elevation of 10,300 feet, on a steep Western aspect. Dry Bulb 60 degrees, RH 25%. Winds are 1-3 miles per hour from the West, Probability of Ignition Unshaded is 50%, Shaded is 40%. I repeat, Dry Bulb 60 degrees, RH 25%. How copy?
